etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: Borrowed from Latin būcolicus, from Ancient Greek βουκολικός (boukolikós, “rustic, pastoral; meter used by pastoral poets”, literally “pertaining to cowherds”).
senses: Relating to the pleasant aspects of rustic country life.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Latin būcolicum, neuter substantive of būcolicus.
